scope: Retrospective end-to-end regression of saved real model responses, not new blind model accuracy

cold_chain.network: Frozen undirected cycle on the full roster, including units outside an evaluated subset
cold_chain.assignment: Independent Bernoulli(1/2) for every unit in the full roster
cold_chain.target: Equal mean of own 1 minus own 0 at high peer exposure; remaining assignments averaged under original design conditional on that event

a4.description: Exact population E[Y_i | Z_i=a, E_i(Z)=e] for each roster unit and each a,e in {0,1}. Independently stipulated for this synthetic test; never inferred from finite records.

a5.description: Entire assignment vector independent of the full potential-outcome schedule conditional on the fixed context; observed outcome equals its realized potential outcome. Network is fixed before assignment; conditional first moments exist.

cold_chain.a6: Every required own/exposure cell must have positive exact design probability; checked by Core and independent enumeration
